machining.difficulty: difficult relative to aluminium and conventional steels
drivers: high chemical reactivity at cutting temperatures

forming.cold_forming: Dependent on grade and section; alpha and CP grades generally more formable than high-strength alpha-beta conditions.
forming.warm_forming: Can materially improve formability for difficult shapes.
forming.springback: Must be considered in precision formed parts.

additive.rule: AM material cards require process-specific qualification.
